verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents non-interactive scripting mode and a GitHub Action integration that runs autonomously in the background (automated PR reviews, issue triage, on-demand @gemini-cli responses), which directly supports background automations. However, independent community reports describe agentic reliability problems (getting stuck in loops, failing simple file operations, ignoring GEMINI.md context) that undercut confidence in unattended/background runs actually completing correctly. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation that scheduled/background automations run reliably end-to-end, and more detail on failure/retry handling in autonomous mode.
